scrollGeometry.visiblePredicate: !(rect.left > viewport.right || rect.right < viewport.left || rect.top > viewport.bottom || rect.bottom < viewport.top)
scrollGeometry.boundaryRule: Touching an edge counts as overlap (strict > / < rejection). Horizontal overlap is checked too.
scrollGeometry.entryExit: Handler is evaluated when elementVisible changes, or initial evaluation is visible; scroll into-view fires on true, out-of-view on false.
scrollGeometry.onceRepeat: If referenced autoStopEventId is absent from ixData.events and state.triggered is true, do not fire again. If companion exists, state changes can retrigger.
scrollGeometry.listeners: Window resize/orientationchange; document scroll/wheel/readystatechange/IX2_PAGE_UPDATE, all source-throttled. Exact throttle interval remains raw-runtime detail.

intersectionObserverConversion.reason: No rootMargin/threshold conversion asserted. Native callback timing, inclusive boundaries and source throttle must be compared in browser.
